summary: .github/copilot-instructions.md exists in this checkout and remains the first project-specific context surface after AGENTS.md.
CURRENT_STATE.md should stay a compact horizon index and should not carry the full developmental memory inline.
JSONL is the right append-only format for milestone settlement history because records can be parsed, appended, diffed, and recovered independently.
state/current_state.json is the low-payment read path for next steps, still-missing gaps, lessons learned, and the last settlement.
Migrated history is preserved substrate, not new metabolized capability; future agents should query it only when the active desired direction requires it.
